name: Kotlin
description: A JVM language for services and Android clients.
rationale: The standard for new JVM services; interoperates with the existing Java estate.

name: Python
description: A general-purpose language for data work, automation and tooling.
rationale: Default for data pipelines, notebooks and internal tooling.

name: Go
description: A compiled language for small network services and command-line tools.
rationale: Use for infrastructure tooling and latency-sensitive services; Kotlin stays the default for business services.

name: Svelte
description: A compiled front-end framework with little runtime.
rationale: Trialled on the partner portal: smaller bundles, but a thinner hiring pool than React.

name: WebAssembly components
description: Portable, sandboxed modules that run in browsers and on servers.
rationale: Assessing for plug-in isolation in the pricing engine.

name: Perl
description: A scripting language used by legacy batch jobs.
rationale: Remaining jobs are being rewritten in Python; no new use.

name: Kubernetes
description: Container orchestration for every hosted workload.
rationale: The managed cluster is the default home for services.

name: PostgreSQL
description: A relational database with strong extension support.
rationale: Default relational store; managed instances in every region.

name: Apache Kafka
description: A durable event log for streaming between services.
rationale: Use where ordering and replay matter; queues remain simpler for plain work distribution.

name: Edge functions
description: Small functions run at the content network's edge.
rationale: Trialling for personalisation of the public site.

name: DuckDB
description: An in-process analytical database.
rationale: Assessing for local analysis of exported datasets.

name: On-premises Hadoop
description: The original batch analytics cluster.
rationale: Workloads are moving to the managed lakehouse; hardware support ends next year.

name: Trunk-based development
description: Short-lived branches merged to main at least daily.
rationale: Shortens feedback loops and makes small, frequent releases routine.

name: Architecture decision records
description: Short documents recording a decision, its options and its reasons.
rationale: Required for decisions that cross team boundaries.

name: Platform engineering
description: An internal platform team offering paved roads as a product.
rationale: A two-quarter trial with three product teams as its customers.

name: Chaos experiments
description: Deliberate fault injection to test resilience.
rationale: Assessing the tooling and the safety controls needed for production.

name: Manual change approval boards
description: A weekly board that approves each production change.
rationale: Slows delivery without reducing failure rates; automated controls replace it. Not for new processes.

name: Terraform
description: Declarative infrastructure as code.
rationale: The standard for provisioning cloud resources.

name: GitHub Actions
description: Continuous integration and delivery in the code host.
rationale: Default pipeline for every repository.

name: AI coding assistants
description: Code completion and chat in the editor.
rationale: A bounded trial measuring review effort and defect rates.

name: OpenTelemetry
description: Vendor-neutral traces, metrics and logs.
rationale: Assessing as the single instrumentation layer before choosing a backend.

name: Low-code workflow builder
description: A hosted designer for business workflows.
rationale: Hard to test and version; revisit when it supports source control.

name: Jenkins
description: The self-hosted build server.
rationale: Pipelines are moving to GitHub Actions.

name: Deno
description: A JavaScript runtime with built-in tooling.
rationale: Nominated for internal scripts; awaiting triage.

name: Java
description: The language of most existing services.
rationale: Graduated from Adopt: established, supported, no longer featured.

name: MongoDB
description: A document database.
rationale: PostgreSQL's JSON support covers the cases proposed.

name: Puppet
description: Configuration management for virtual machines.
rationale: Retirement completed when the last estate moved to images built by Terraform.

name: Pair programming rotations
description: Scheduled rotation of pairing partners.
rationale: Merged into the trunk-based development guidance.
